tagline: Search Hugging Face for GGUF models and download them straight into a models folder the server scans.
authNote: The server has no authentication in v1 — a download writes a file from the internet onto this machine. Keep the server on localhost.
shelvesHint: A small hand-maintained list of search terms. Clicking one runs the same honest Hugging Face search — nothing here is ranked, cached or endorsed.
offlineBody: The server could not reach huggingface.co (its search proxy returned an error). Your network or HF itself may be down — nothing is faked while it is away.
offlineManual: You can still add models manually: download a .gguf anywhere and drop it into one of the scanned folders, then scan it on the Models page.
emptyBody: Try a broader term — the search only returns repositories that contain .gguf files.
filesHint: Pick one file to download. The quant tag is guessed from the filename and can be wrong.
targetDirHint: Only folders the server already scans for models are allowed — anything else is rejected by the server (HTTP 403).
dlEmpty: No downloads yet — open a repository's files to start one.
dlDeleteTitle: Remove this task from the panel — a running download stops and its partial file is removed. For a finished download you choose whether the model file is also deleted.
dlDeleteDoneBody: {{filename}} ({{size}}) finished downloading. How do you want to remove it?
dlDeleteWarn: Deleting the model file from disk cannot be undone, and a model that is currently loaded cannot be deleted (unload it first).
dlDeleteRefs: Referenced by {{convs}} conversations and {{assistants}} assistants — deleting the file means they cannot load this model until it is downloaded again.
dlClearRefs: {{count}} of these model files are referenced by conversations or assistants — deleting them breaks those references.
dlFileNotDeletedBody: The task was removed, but the model file could not be deleted — it may already be missing, locked by another program, or outside the allowed model folders.
loadNowBody: {{filename}} finished downloading — load it into the server now?
loadNowNote: Uses the server's current default buffer and context (see Settings → Server). Loading a large model can take a while and cannot be cancelled.
dlNote: Resume continues from the saved partial file, not from byte 0. Deleting a task removes it from this panel; for a finished download you can also delete the model file (a confirmation dialog appears).
dlClearAllBody: {{count}} finished downloads will be removed from this panel. Downloads still in progress are kept.
dlClearFilesToo: Also delete the model files of the {{count}} completed downloads
dlClearWarn: Deleting model files from disk cannot be undone. Files of models that are currently loaded are kept, and failed/cancelled downloads have no model file to delete.
dlClearNoFiles: None of these finished downloads completed, so no model file will be touched — only the task rows are removed.
dlClearSkipped: {{count}} model files kept — loaded, locked, missing, or outside the allowed model folders.
detailOffline: Hugging Face is unreachable — cannot load details.
contextNaHint: Hugging Face does not publish a context length for this repository.
ramHint: Estimated from each quant's real file size on disk (about the weights held in RAM). Actual use varies with context length and settings.
noDescription: No description provided by Hugging Face.
perfNa: Strengths / weaknesses / performance: Hugging Face does not publish benchmarks, so none are shown here — nothing is estimated.
filesGroupHint: Cards group files by quant (one badge per quant). This panel lists every file, including each shard.
perFileNa: Download counts are per repository only — Hugging Face does not provide per-file counts.
shardNeedsAll: Download together — {{n}} parts make one model.
nonGgufNote: These are not models (e.g. README, imatrix) — the server only downloads .gguf files.
latestHint: Newest GGUF models by last update, straight from Hugging Face — not ranked or endorsed by us.
recHint: Models we measured on the reference machine (12 GB VRAM / 64 GB RAM) with the Thai quality gate — every number links to its experiment evidence. Download fetches exactly the quant we tested.
recCaveat: Numbers were measured on the project's reference machine (i9-9900KF · RTX 3060 12 GB · 64 GB RAM). Your hardware will differ — the Thai verdict and the relative ordering between quants are the portable part.
recCaveatHint: Honest-telemetry rule: measured ranges only, never projected.
recTokHint: Measured generation speed on the reference rig (clean room, same llama-server build).
recExpTitle: Experiment record with the full measurement
recFlagsHint: llama-server flags used in the measurement
